services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: The Garden Hills Adult Swim Team - Atlanta Adult Swim League Champions in 2018, 2019, and 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025, will make another run for those prestigious championship towels in 2026! The adult league, now known as “Grownup Swimming”, is planning 4 summer “regular meets” and, of course, the all-important Championship Meet to be held in August. The team will be embarking on our 19th season this summer. And thanks to our teammate, Corinne Nabors, we now have a digital clock so we can easily see our times as we train! services.name: FREE Water Polo Clinic
services.desc: The clinic is open to rising 6th - rising 12th graders, boys and girls, no experience necessary! Come learn how to play water polo with real players and coaches. The APS Knights are a club team, open to any middle or high school student living within the Atlanta Public Schools district, even if you attend a private school. Most Knights players start with no experience - all you need to join is the ability to swim freestyle and tread water. They have different level teams for different ages and ability levels.
